title: SharePoint Lead – Project & Team Management
description:
**Position:** SharePoint Lead – Project & Team Management  
**Experience:** 7+ Years  
**Location:** Mumbai, India – Work from Office  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **SharePoint Lead** with 7+ years of experience in Microsoft SharePoint development, implementation, administration, and solution architecture, along with strong project management and team leadership skills.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for leading SharePoint projects end-to-end, managing a technical team, coordinating with stakeholders, and delivering scalable, secure, and efficient SharePoint solutions. The candidate should have hands-on technical expertise and the ability to manage project timelines, resources, deliverables, and client expectations.

Key Responsibilities1. SharePoint Technical Leadership

* Lead the design, development, implementation, and maintenance of SharePoint solutions.
* Work with SharePoint Online, Microsoft 365, SharePoint Framework (SPFx), Power Automate, Power Apps, and Microsoft Teams integrations.
* Define solution architecture, technical standards, development guidelines, and best practices.
* Manage SharePoint sites, document libraries, lists, permissions, workflows, metadata, and content management.
* Lead SharePoint migrations, upgrades, modernization, and integration projects.
* Ensure security, governance, performance, scalability, and compliance across SharePoint environments.
* Troubleshoot complex technical issues and provide guidance to developers and administrators.

2. Project Management

* Manage the complete project lifecycle, including requirement gathering, planning, estimation, execution, testing, deployment, and support.
* Prepare project plans, delivery schedules, resource allocation plans, and progress reports.
* Track project milestones, risks, dependencies, budgets, and deliverables.
* Coordinate with clients, business stakeholders, project managers, and cross-functional teams.
* Conduct requirement analysis and translate business needs into technical solutions.
* Ensure projects are delivered within agreed timelines, scope, and quality standards.
* Manage change requests, escalations, and stakeholder expectations.

3. Team Management and Leadership

* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of SharePoint developers, consultants, and administrators.
* Allocate tasks, monitor productivity, and ensure timely delivery of assigned work.
* Conduct code reviews, technical discussions, performance reviews, and knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Support team members in resolving technical challenges and improving development practices.
* Identify training needs and develop team capabilities.
* Foster collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement within the team.

4. Client and Stakeholder Management

* Act as the primary technical point of contact for SharePoint projects.
* Conduct client meetings, requirement workshops, and solution demonstrations.
* Present technical solutions, project status, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders.
* Build strong client relationships and ensure customer satisfaction.
* Collaborate with business analysts, architects, QA teams, infrastructure teams, and other technology specialists.

Required Skills and Qualifications

* Minimum **7+ years of overall experience** in SharePoint development, implementation, consulting, or administration.
* Strong hands-on experience with SharePoint Online and Microsoft 365.
* Experience with SharePoint architecture, site collections, lists, libraries, permissions, workflows, and content management.
* Proficiency in SharePoint Framework (SPFx), JavaScript/TypeScript, React, HTML, CSS, and REST APIs, as applicable to project requirements.
* Experience with Power Automate and Power Apps for workflow automation and business process solutions.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Graph API, Azure, Entra ID (Azure AD), and Microsoft 365 integrations.
* Experience in SharePoint migration, customization, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
* Strong understanding of SharePoint governance, security, access control, and information architecture.
* Demonstrated experience in project planning, estimation, execution, and delivery management.
* Proven ability to lead and manage a technical team.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

* Microsoft certifications related to SharePoint, Microsoft 365, Power Platform, or Azure.
* Experience with SharePoint migration tools and third-party migration solutions.
* Exposure to Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Teams, Power BI, and enterprise document management.
* Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment.
* Experience managing multiple projects or client engagements simultaneously.
* Experience in client-facing consulting or IT services organizations.

Key Competencies

* Technical leadership and solution design
* Project planning and delivery management
* Team leadership, mentoring, and resource management
* Client communication and stakeholder coordination
* Risk management and problem resolution
* Quality assurance and process improvement
* Ownership, accountability, and decision-making

Success Criteria

* Timely and high-quality delivery of SharePoint projects.
* Effective management and utilization of technical resources.
* High client satisfaction and successful stakeholder engagement.
* Adherence to technical standards, security, and governance requirements.
* Improved team productivity, delivery predictability, and solution quality.

Work Location

**Mumbai, Maharashtra, India – Work from Office**

Candidates should be willing to work from the Mumbai office.

How to Apply

Interested candidates with strong SharePoint technical expertise and proven project and team management experience are encouraged to apply with their updated resume, highlighting relevant projects, team size managed, and project delivery responsibilities.

description:

**Designation**: Assistant Manager - Automation & Innovation - Global Service Centre

**Location**: Ghansoli, Navi Mumbai

**Primary Purpose:**

To lead the technical design, development standards, mentoring, training, and delivery governance for RPA

/ automation platforms and related automation solutions.

This role is critical because the team will include junior external hires as well as internal resources who

need to transition into RPA delivery capability.

**Key Role Responsibilities:**

 Lead the design and development of solutions using approved RPA / automation platforms.

 Define automation development standards, including workflow structure, selectors, exception handling,

logging, retry logic, testing, and documentation.

 Guide Automation Engineers in workflow design, debugging, selector creation, and production-readiness.

 Train and mentor internal Senior Automation Specialists to develop hands-on RPA skills.

 Establish a structured upskilling path for internal resources from Power Automate / BI / macro capability

into RPA / automation platform workflow development and automation support.

 Review automation designs before UAT and production deployment.

 Support complex debugging across browser automation, desktop automation, Excel, files, APIs, and

application workflows.

 Support architecture decisions for RPA / automation platforms, workflow orchestration, Windows runtime

 Work with IT teams on VM setup, robot accounts, browser extensions, permissions, and deployment

requirements.

 Provide guidance on when to use RPA / automation platform, Power Automate, macros, Python, API-based

automation, or other tools. Help build reusable components, templates, runbooks, and automation support practices.

 Ensure internal resources are not only process contributors but are progressively capable of building,

testing, and supporting automations.

**Skills & Competencies:**

 8-12+ years of experience in automation, RPA, software development, or enterprise application

automation.

 Strong hands-on experience in at least one major RPA platform such as major RPA / automation platforms,

desktop automation tools, or equivalent automation tools.

 Strong understanding of workflow design, exception handling, retry logic, logging, and production support.

 Good knowledge of selectors, including XPath, CSS selectors, and Windows UI Automation.

 Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills.

 Experience with Git or structured version control.

 Ability to mentor junior developers and train non-RPA internal resources into structured automation

developers.

 Good stakeholder communication and documentation skills.

**Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills**

 Experience with RPA platforms and workflow orchestration tools.

 Python knowledge.

 C# / .NET exposure.

 Node-RED or JavaScript knowledge.

 Power Automate, Power BI, and Excel macro/VBA exposure.

 API integration and JSON handling experience.

 Docker or basic infrastructure understanding.

 Agentic AI or AI-assisted automation awareness.

**Success Measures**

 Automation Engineers become productive within 2-3 months.

 Internal Senior Automation Specialists develop basic RPA / automation platform capability within 3 months.

 Internal Senior Automation Specialists can support or modify simple automations within 3-6 months.

 Team follows consistent standards for workflow design, selectors, logging, error handling, and

documentation.

 Production issues reduce through better design and reusable components.

 Clear development, testing, deployment, and support practices are established.

title: Key Account Manager Healthcare Global Account Program, Mumbai
description:
It's more than a job
  
  
With a sales career at Kuehne+Nagel, you'll drive long-term business success by mastering sales strategies, nurturing customer relationships and identifying new opportunities. But you will also bring relief and peace of mind to pet owners around the world. Because when you do your job, your colleagues around the world are able to build reliable veterinary supply chains that ensure pets get the care they need. At Kuehne+Nagel, our work is about more than we imagine.
  
  
‎
  
  
The Key Account Manager (KAM) is responsible for the end-to-end commercial customer journey (any relationship management and business development activities) related to his/her dedicated portfolio of accounts in the assigned scope of responsibility (GKAM or Network KAM).
  
  
Acts in that scope as the leading KN representative towards the customer across all KN services and business units, who qualifies account intelligence and translates same into addressable business targets. All captured in an evolving and agreed account plan/customer strategy process. Maintains and develops direct and personal relations with key customer stakeholders, and conducts key account management activities in accordance with KN’s Key Account Program guidelines.
  
  
Has a strong reach across the KN network including business units and supportive functional units, expert ability to translate the customers' requirements into an achievable plan and align with the business units and supportive functional units to action such business opportunities.
  
  
How you create impact
  
  

* Directly manages Key Account, in accordance with agreed targets, goals and based on company guidelines, eliciting customer needs and selling KN offer portfolio
* Understands the customers organization and decision making process
* Understands the customers business model and business environment as well as the competitive environment of the customer
* Negotiates rates and service contracts with customers in alignment with the BU’s and ensures all commercial requirements are documented and maintained as needed by the BU’
* Understand, at an expert level, the vertical service offerings of KN
* Complies with KN sales management processes and systems and ensures correct and timely updates (CRM/CoreLog system)
* Monitors monthly performance (pipeline, wins, losses, RFP opportunities, consulting activities, financial related including Days Sales Outstanding and Credit) against set targets, and ensures immediate actions taken in case of deviations (incl. timely / accurate reporting)
* Ensures that account plan is in place based on the Key Account Planning Process and template and signed off by the respective sales manager
* Effectively hands over and transitions new business into operations to ensure that customer requirements and KN commitments are met
* Conduct regular and structured review sessions with assigned customers including; process for continuous improvement and innovation, review of customer strategy and priorities as well as operational excellence delivery

What we would like you to bring
  
  

* Minimum 5 years of Key Account Management experience.
* Healthcare or pharmaceutical industry exposure.
* Proven business development and revenue growth track record.
* Knowledge of international logistics and freight forwarding.
* Experience managing global or regional accounts.
* Exposure to APAC markets and international networks.
* Strong account planning, upselling and cross-selling skills.
* Experience in sales targets, pricing and contract negotiations.
* Strong stakeholder management and English communication skills.
* Ability to drive commercial opportunities and coordinate with global teams.

What's in it for you
  
  

* Work with a Global Leader – Join one of the world’s top logistics companies with a strong international presence and reputation.
* Career Development – Access structured growth opportunities, professional training, and internal mobility within a global organization.
* Attractive Compensation – Competitive salary with performance-based incentives and benefits.
* Collaborative Work Culture – Be part of a supportive, ethical, and compliance-driven team environment.
* Local Role, Global Impact – Influence regional business growth while working with global tools, systems, and best practices.

Who we are
  
  
Logistics shapes everyday life - from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.
  
As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine.

title: Salesforce Architect – Service 2.0
description:
#### **Job Description**


Job Description
  

Salesforce Architect – Service 2\.0
  

About Service 2\.0
  

Service 2\.0 is Blue Star's three\-year transformation of the Unitary Products service business, moving from reactive complaint handling to proactive ownership of the customer experience.
  

The programme is redesigning the complete customer journey — from installation and warranty onboarding through breakdown, repair, closure and renewal — on a modern service technology stack comprising Salesforce as the system of record, Salesforce Field Service (FSL) for the technician workforce, a bi\-directional integration backbone with SAP and partner systems, and a WhatsApp\-first customer communication layer.
  

The transformation includes GenAI\-powered service bots and self\-service, intelligent ticket allocation, workforce capacity optimisation, mobile\-first field workflows, digital proof\-of\-work, AI\-assisted audit, predictive analytics and role\-based performance dashboards.
  

The programme operates across a pan\-India service ecosystem of partners and technicians and is measured through business outcomes including warranty cost, first\-time\-fix rate, turnaround time and customer satisfaction.
  

Role: Salesforce Architect – Service 2\.0
  

We are looking for an experienced Salesforce Architect to own the technology architecture and solution design for the Service 2\.0 transformation.
  

The person will be responsible for translating business and service transformation objectives into a scalable Salesforce architecture covering Salesforce Service Cloud, Salesforce Field Service, integrations, digital channels, automation, analytics and AI/GenAI capabilities.
  

The role will work closely with business leaders, service operations, IT teams, Salesforce/product teams, integration teams, partners and implementation vendors to establish a robust architecture that can scale across Blue Star's pan\-India service network.
  

Key Responsibilities
  

1\. Salesforce Architecture \& Solution Design
  

* Own the end\-to\-end Salesforce architecture for Service 2\.0\.
* Define the target architecture across Salesforce Service Cloud, Salesforce Field Service, Experience Cloud/digital channels and supporting Salesforce capabilities.
* Translate business requirements and service\-process designs into scalable, secure and maintainable Salesforce solutions.
* Define application, data, integration and security architecture.
* Establish architecture principles, design standards and reusable patterns.
* Evaluate new Salesforce capabilities and recommend their adoption where they create measurable business value.
* Ensure the architecture remains scalable for future service transformation initiatives.

2\. Field Service \& Technician Transformation
  

* Architect Salesforce Field Service solutions supporting the complete technician lifecycle.
* Design solutions for work\-order management, intelligent scheduling, dispatch, technician allocation, capacity planning, mobility and digital proof\-of\-work.
* Enable optimisation of technician productivity, travel, skill matching, SLA adherence and first\-time\-fix.
* Design mobile\-first experiences suitable for a large and diverse pan\-India technician ecosystem.
* Ensure solutions work effectively across service partners and different operating models.

3\. Customer Service \& Digital Experience
  

* Architect end\-to\-end customer journeys across complaint registration, service request, appointment, technician visit, repair, closure and renewal.
* Design WhatsApp\-first and digital self\-service journeys integrated with Salesforce.
* Define architecture for GenAI\-powered service bots and assisted customer\-service journeys.
* Enable consistent customer interactions across digital and assisted service channels.
* Ensure customer, asset, warranty and service history are available as a unified view.

4\. Integration Architecture
  

* Own the Salesforce integration architecture with SAP, partner systems, WhatsApp and other enterprise applications.
* Define API, event\-driven and bi\-directional integration patterns.
* Ensure reliable synchronisation of customer, product, asset, warranty, service and transaction data.
* Establish standards for integration security, monitoring, error handling, retry mechanisms and performance.
* Work with integration architects and technology teams to build a scalable integration backbone.

5\. AI, GenAI \& Intelligent Service
  

* Define the architecture for AI/GenAI use cases within the service ecosystem.
* Identify opportunities to use AI for customer self\-service, case classification and summarisation, technician assistance, smart ticket allocation, capacity and demand forecasting, audit and anomaly detection, and predictive service analytics.
* Ensure AI solutions are integrated appropriately into Salesforce workflows and user experiences.
* Establish governance around data, security, accuracy and responsible AI adoption.

6\. Data, Analytics \& Performance Management
  

* Define the Salesforce data architecture supporting service analytics and reporting.
* Ensure data quality, consistency and availability across the service ecosystem.
* Enable role\-based dashboards for service leaders, managers, partners and field teams.
* Work with data and analytics teams to enable predictive service insights.
* Establish architecture that supports measurement of warranty cost, first\-time\-fix, turnaround time, technician productivity and customer satisfaction.

7\. Governance \& Technical Leadership
  

* Act as the technical authority for Salesforce architecture within Service 2\.0\.
* Review and approve solution designs, technical specifications and major changes.
* Establish Salesforce development, configuration, integration and release\-management standards.
* Drive technical debt reduction and platform optimisation.
* Ensure appropriate Salesforce licensing and platform utilisation.
* Conduct architecture reviews and ensure adherence to enterprise architecture and security standards.
* Mentor Salesforce developers, administrators and implementation partners.

8\. Partner \& Programme Management
  

* Work closely with Salesforce, system integrators and technology partners.
* Provide technical direction to implementation partners and ensure adherence to the target architecture.
* Challenge solution designs where required and ensure commercial and technical decisions are aligned.
* Support programme planning, estimation, prioritisation and technology\-roadmap decisions.
* Ensure successful transition from implementation to sustainable operations and support.

Key Deliverables / Success Measures
  

The Salesforce Architect will be expected to deliver:
  

* Robust target\-state Salesforce architecture for Service 2\.0\.
* Scalable Salesforce Service Cloud and Field Service architecture across the pan\-India service network.
* Seamless integration between Salesforce, SAP, partners and digital channels.
* Mobile\-first and technician\-centric service workflows.
* Intelligent allocation, scheduling and capacity\-management capabilities.
* WhatsApp\-first customer engagement and self\-service journeys.
* AI/GenAI\-enabled service capabilities with measurable business value.
* Reliable service data and performance dashboards.
* Strong platform governance, security, scalability and maintainability.
* Reduction in technical debt and unnecessary customisation.
* Architecture aligned to measurable improvements in warranty cost, first\-time\-fix rate, service turnaround time, technician productivity and customer satisfaction.

Candidate Profile
  

Education
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline.
* Relevant Salesforce certifications are strongly preferred.

Experience
  

* 10–15\+ years of overall technology experience, with significant experience in Salesforce architecture and enterprise application transformation.
* Strong hands\-on architecture experience across Salesforce Service Cloud and Salesforce Field Service.
* Experience designing large\-scale Salesforce implementations involving complex integrations and multiple stakeholder groups.
* Experience in field service, after\-sales service, customer service or service transformation is highly desirable.
* Experience working with large distributed field/service networks is an advantage.
* Experience in enterprise\-scale digital transformation programmes involving multiple technology platforms.

Salesforce Expertise
  

Strong understanding of:
  

* Salesforce Service Cloud
